33|    message(FATAL_ERROR "Do not build in-source.\nPlease remove CMakeCache.txt and the CMakeFiles/ directory.\nThen: mkdir build ; cd build ; cmake .. ; make")
34|endif()

38|set(_CMARK_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS_DEFAULT NO)

40|  message(AUTHOR_WARNING [=[
41|'CMARK_SHARED' has been replaced with the standard 'BUILD_SHARED_LIBS' to control the library type.
42|]=])
43|  set(_CMARK_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS_DEFAULT ${CMARK_SHARED})
44|endif()

48|]=])
49|  if(NOT CMARK_STATIC)
50|    set(_CMARK_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS_DEFAULT YES)
51|  else()
52|    set(_CMARK_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS_DEFAULT NO)
53|  endif()
54|endif()

56|option(CMARK_LIB_FUZZER "Build libFuzzer fuzzing harness" OFF)
57|option(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS "Build the CMark library as shared"
58|  ${_CMARK_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS_DEFAULT})
59|
60|if(NOT MSVC)
61|  set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 99)
62|  set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED YES)
63|  set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS NO)
64|endif()
65|
66|# -fvisibility=hidden
67|set(CMAKE_C_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden)
68|set(CMAKE_VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN 1)
69|
70|set(CMAKE_INCLUDE_CURRENT_DIR ON)
71|
72|# Check integrity of node structure when compiled as debug
73|add_compile_options($<$<CONFIG:Debug>:-DCMARK_DEBUG_NODES>)
74|
75|# In order to maintain compatibility with older platforms which may not have a
76|# recent version of CMake (i.e. are running CMake <3.3), we cannot simply use
77|# the `add_compile_options` with a generator expression.  This uses the
78|# `target_compile_options` with `PRIVATE` to add the flags only to the targets
79|# so that CMark may be used in projects with non-C languages.
80|function(cmark_add_compile_options target)
81|  if(MSVC)
82|    target_compile_definitions(${target} PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
83|  else()
84|    target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE
85|            -Wall -Wextra -pedantic
86|            $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:-Wstrict-prototypes>)
87|  endif()
88|  if(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE MATCHES profile)
89|    target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -pg)
90|  endif()
91|  if(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE MATCHES ubsan)
92|    target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -fsanitize=undefined)
93|  endif()
94|  if(CMARK_LIB_FUZZER)
95|    if(target MATCHES fuzz)
96|      target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer)
97|      target_link_options(${target} PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer)
98|    else()
99|      target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer-no-link)
100|      target_link_options(${target} PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer-no-link)
101|    endif()
102|  endif()
103|endfunction()

108|if(NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL Windows)

110|endif()

113|  add_subdirectory(test testdir)
114|endif()
115|if(CMARK_LIB_FUZZER)
116|  add_subdirectory(fuzz)
117|endif()
118|

120|  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE "Release" CACHE STRING
121|  "Choose the type of build, options are: Debug Profile Release Asan Ubsan." FORCE)
122|endif(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
